title: Wildberries Has Asked the State for Eight Hundred Billion Rubles
subtitle: The marketplace requested 500 billion rubles to compensate sellers and a further 300 billion rubles to buy air defence for its own warehouses.

source.name: Wildberries requests to the Russian government reported by Russian business media

data.label: Compensation for sellers
data.annotation: Money for merchants whose goods were destroyed or locked in damaged warehouses.

data.label: Air defence for warehouses
data.annotation: A private company asking the budget to militarise its own logistics estate.

primaryMetric.label: total requested from the federal budget

supportingFacts.label: The company cancelled acquisitions and paused investment programmes while the requests were outstanding.
Compensation diverts budget money away from the army, strengthening the case for further strikes.

metadata.keyFinding: Wildberries asked for 800 billion rubles, including 300 billion for air defence.
